name: mcp-server-crewhu
description: MCP server for Crewhu — customer feedback (CSAT/NPS), employee engagement, gamification, badges, and prize management
long_description: Provides AI assistants with structured access to Crewhu. List and search customer feedback surveys (including NPS detractors and promoters), look up employee/user records, manage recognition badges and contest targets, and inspect prize catalog + redemption history through the Model Context Protocol.
